t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Choose whichever gnome you want to it is an entirely randomised study and there in rhyme or reason to wheter you get 5 times the score or 1 times the score. Good luck! Happy mushrooming!

vb_textbox.text: There seems to be no rhyme or reason to which gnome to choose - main aim seems to be to make sure you add the mushrooms in time and try not to fall asleep - good luck! Just don't miss collecting any mushrooms in your fancy schmancy basket :-)!
